findings.description: comp_tickets only calls require_login, so any authenticated attendee can call the tickets.comp route. It creates zero-price tickets for any holder_id, up to 50 per request with no limit on repeated requests. The sibling admin route cancel_event and the staff route attendee_list both enforce a role, so this endpoint is an authorization bypass that lets ordinary users mint free tickets and consume event capacity.
findings.suggestion: Replace require_login with require_role(request.user, Role.STAFF, Role.ADMIN) (or the intended comp role), keeping the user object for issued_by.
findings.title: Any logged-in user can issue free complimentary tickets
